# Cross Designs

> A South Florida web design and SEO studio founded and run by Aiden Camacho (Cross), based in Kendall. Custom hand-built websites, website revamps, and local SEO for small and local businesses. The studio builds your site new or revamps the one you have, then ranks it on Google, so clients deal with a single point of contact instead of separate freelancers. Available to clients nationwide.

## Services and rates
- Web design (https://crossdesigned.com/services/web-design/): custom, mobile-first small business sites. From $1,500, quoted up front, live in about a week. A $0-down plan gets the same build from $150 a month on a 12-month term, with the site fully owned by the client at the end of the term.
- Website revamp / redesign (https://crossdesigned.com/services/website-redesign/): rebuilds that keep the domain and rankings and replace the dated template. Same starting price of $1,500 as new builds, and the $0-down plan applies here too.
- Local SEO (https://crossdesigned.com/services/local-seo/): service pages, area pages, schema markup, Google Business Profile alignment, honest reporting. From $300 a month with site maintenance and any changes included. For clients who prefer not to pay the monthly, a performance option replaces it: no fee and 10% of tracked sales generated by the site, tracking agreed up front. Available with both flat builds and the $0-down plan.
- Free website review: any business can submit its current site on the homepage (https://crossdesigned.com/#free-review) and get back an honest teardown of what is costing it leads, at no charge.

## Policies
- Privacy policy (https://crossdesigned.com/privacy/): what is collected through the site, what it is used for, who processes it, and how to have it deleted. No selling or sharing of visitor data, no advertising trackers.
- Terms of use (https://crossdesigned.com/terms/): site terms, quote and pricing terms, and an explicit statement that no specific Google ranking is guaranteed.
